title: The Paper Whale Over the Canal
summary: A 45-second Canvas 2D animated loop where a child's paper boat unfolds into a gilded whale soaring above a snowy lantern-lit canal.
description: A 45-second illustrated Canvas 2D loop. A boatman lights lanterns along a snowy canal as a child launches a paper boat whose folds open into a gilded whale above the pagoda roofs, rounding the belltower before dissolving back toward the water as gold snow.
